argv: Handoff: Golden goal — full task in thread <thread> (arrives as a herdr-threads message; if not shown, run `herdr-threads --state-dir <root>/state --host-endpoint <root>/host.sock inbox`).
launch.next: the agent's session-start hook shows pending invitations and messages; if its initial prompt is lost, the idle agent is woken for pending work, and `herdr-threads inbox --seat <seat>` still lists it
launch.receipt: launch is not receipt: nothing was checked in, accepted or ACKed
